निश् 1. निश्, euphonically substituted for
निस् before च्, छ्, &c.

निश् 2. निश्, cl. 1. P. -नेशति, &c., to
meditate upon, meditate profoundly, to
be absorbed in meditation.

निश् 3. निश्, f. (perhaps connected with
नक् fr. rt. 2. नश्, or merely a curtailed form of निशा
below, which may be connected with नि-शीथ and
so derived fr. rt. शी with नि; the form निश् is
defective in nom. voc. sing. du. and pl., acc. sing.
du., but may be optionally substituted for निशा in
acc. pl. and remaining cases, e. g. निशस् or निशास्,
निशा or निशया, निड्भ्याम् [according to some also
निज्भ्याम्] or निशाभ्याम्, &c.), night; निशि निशि,
every night; महा-निशि, at midnight.

निष् 1. निष्, euphonically substituted for
निस् before क्, ख्, ट्, &c.

निष् 2. निष् [cf. rt. निक्ष्], cl. 1. P.
नेषति, &c., to moisten, sprinkle.

निस् निस्, ind. (as a preposition or prefix
to verbs and their derivative nouns, expressing) out,
forth, outward, out of, out from, away, away from;
(निस् is used as an independent and separable adverb in
Atharva-veda
XVI. 2, 1

.)
निस् is also prefixed to nouns, not immediately con-
nected with verbs, in the sense ‘out of,’ ‘away
from’ [cf. निर्-वन], but more commonly in the
sense of a privative or negative adverb = 3. अ, ‘no,’
‘not,’ ‘without.’ In this latter signification it may
form either negative substantives (e. g. fr. अर्थ, ad-
vantage, निर्-अर्थ, disadvantage) or more frequently
adjectives (e. g. fr. मल, a stain, निर्-मल, stain-
less). निस् is liable to be euphonically changed to
निर्, निः, निश्, निष् or नी [cf. नी-रस, &c.] accord-
ing to the letter which follows it.

निश, अम्, n. (at the end of a comp.) = निशा,
night (e. g. अहर्-निशम्, ind. day and night; दिवा-
निशम्, ind. day and night; cf. also अ-निश.)

निशा, f. night; a vision, dream; turmeric, Cur-
cuma (of two species, = हरिद्रा and दारु-हरिद्रा,
probably C. Zedoaria and C. Longa; a collective N.
of the asterisms Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer,
Sagittarius, and Capricorn; cf. निशा-बल.)
—निशा-
कर, अस्, m. ‘the night-maker,’ the moon, (regarded
with दिवा-कर as a son of Garuḍa); a symbolical
expression for the numeral one; a cock.
—निशा-
कर-कला-मौलि, इस्, m. ‘bearing a crescent as
diadem,’ an epithet of Śiva.
—निशा-काल, अस्, m.
the time of night.
—निशा-केतु, उस्, m. ‘night-sign,’
the moon.
—निशा-क्षय, अस्, m. the close of night.
—निशा-गण, अस्, m. a number of nights.
—निशा-
गम (˚शा-आग्˚), अस्, m. the coming on or com-
mencement of night.
—निशा-गृह, अस्, m. a bed-
room, sleeping-room.
—निशा-चर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्,
going or moving about by night, nocturnal, night-
walking; (अस्), m. a Rākṣasa, a fiend, an imp or
goblin; an epithet of Śiva [cf. निशाचर-पति]; a
jackal; an owl; a snake; the ruddy goose, Cakra-
vāka; a thief; a ghost, an evil spirit; (ई), f. a she-
devil, a female fiend; a woman who goes to an as-
signation, a harlot, whore; a sort of perfume, (see
केशिनी.)
—निशाचर-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of night-
walkers,’ an epithet of Śiva.
—निशाचरेश (˚र-
ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of the Rākṣasas,’ an epithet of
Rāvaṇa.
—निशा-चर्मन्, अ, n. ‘the skin of night,’
darkness.
—निशा-छद, अस्, m. a species of plant.
—निशा-जल, अम्, n. ‘the water of night,’ hoar-
frost, frost, dew.
—निशाट (˚शा-अट), अस्, m. ‘roving
by night,’ an owl; a demon, a ghost.
—निशाटक,
अस्, m. bdellium (= गुग्गुलु, connected with नि-
शाट, an owl; cf. कौशिक, = owl and bdellium,
उलूखल, उलूखलक).
—निशाटन (˚शा-अट्˚), अस्,
m. ‘night-rover,’ an owl; (ई), f. a species of moth.
—निशातिक्रम (˚शा-अत्˚), अस्, m. the passing away
of night.
—निशात्यय (˚शा-अत्˚), अस्, m. the close of
night, day-break.
—निशा-दर्शिन्, ई, m. ‘seeing at
night,’ an owl.
—निशादि (˚शा-आदि), इस्, f. the begin-
ning of night, evening, twilight.
—निशाधीश (˚शा-
अध्˚), अस्, m. ‘lord of night,’ the moon.
—निशा-
नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord of night,’ the moon.
—निशा-
नारायण, अस्, m., N. of a poet.
—निशा-निशम्,
ind. night by night, every night, always.
—१. नि-
शान्त (˚शा-अन्˚), अस्, अम्, m. n. (for 2. नि-शान्त
see under नि-शम्, p. 505, col. 1), the end of
night, break of day.
—निशान्ध (˚शा-अन्˚),
[]
अस्, आ, अम्, blind at night; (आ), f. a species of
creeper (= जतुका).
—निशा-पति, इस्, m. ‘husband
of the night,’ the moon; camphor.
—निशा-पुत्र,
आस्, m. pl. ‘the sons of night,’ N. of certain demons.
—निशा-पुष्प, अस्, m. ‘the flower of night,’ the
white water-lily; hoar-frost, dew.
—निशा-प्राणे-
श्वर, अस्, m. ‘husband of night,’ the moon.
—निशा-बल, अस्, m. a collective N. of the signs of
the zodiac Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Sagit-
tarius, and Capricorn.
—निशा-भङ्गा, f. a species
of plant (= दुग्ध-पुच्छी).
—निशा-मणि, इस्, m.
‘jewel of the night,’ the moon; [cf. ध्वजाग्र-
निशामणि.]
—निशा-मुख, अम्, n. the beginning
of night.
—निशा-मृग, अस्, m. ‘night-animal,’ a
jackal.
—१. निशा-रण, अम्, n. a nocturnal battle; (for
2. see नि-शरण below.)
—निशा-रत्न, अम्, n. (or,
according to some, अस् m.), ‘the jewel of the night,’
the moon.
—निशार्धकाल (˚शा-अर्ध-क्˚), अस्, m.
the first part of the night (opposed to the following).
—निशावसान (˚शा-अव्˚), अम्, n. the close or end
of night, the second part of the night (opposed to
the preceding).
—निशा-विहार, अस्, m. a night-
walker, a nocturnal imp or goblin, a Rākṣasa.
—निशा-वृन्द, अम्, n. a number of nights.
—निशा-
वेदिन्, ई, m. ‘knowing the night,’ a cock.
—निशा-
हस, अस्, m. ‘night-smiler,’ the white water-lily
which opens its petals at night.
—निशाह्वा (˚शा-
आह्˚), f. turmeric.
—निशि-पाल, अस्, m. a kind of
metre consisting of four lines of fifteen syllables
each.
—निशि-पुष्पा or निशि-पुष्पी or निशिपुष्-
पिका, f. the tree Nyctanthes Arbor Tristis.
—निशेश
(˚श-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of night,’ the moon.
—नि-
शैत (˚श-एत), अस्, m. ‘shining at night,’ the crane,
Ardea Nivea.
—निशोत्सर्ग (˚शा-उत्˚), अस्, m. the
end of night, day-break.
—निशोपशाय (˚शा-उप्˚),
अस्, m. resting at night.

निशठ नि-शठ, अस्, आ, अम्, not false,
candid, honest; (अस्), m., N. of a Vṛṣṇi, a son of
Bala-rāma by Revatī; (also written नि-षठ, नि-
सठ, नि-सथ.)
निषठ नि-षठ. See नि-शठ, p. 505.

निशद् नि-शद्, Caus. -शातयति, -यितुम्, Ved.
to kill.

निषद् 1. नि-षद् (नि-सद्), cl. 1. 6. P. -षी-^1
दति, -षत्तुम्, to sit down, lie down, recline; to
settle down, sink down; to dwell; to be afflicted,
suffer pain: Caus. -षादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
sit down.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161213. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/322, batch 316-318.

2. नि-षद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. sitting inactive; (त्), f.
sitting, especially near the altar at a sacrificial rite;
N. of a kind of composition mentioned with Upa-
niṣad in Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 1613.

निशब्द नि-शब्द, अस्, आ, अम्, speechless,
silent; [cf. निः-शब्द.]

निशम् नि-शम्, cl. 4. P. -शाम्यति, -शमितुम्,
to observe, see; to hear, listen: Caus. -शामयति,
-यितुम्, to observe, perceive, see; to hear, listen.

नि-शमन, अम्, n. looking at; seeing, sight;
hearing; becoming aware of.

नि-शम्य, ind. having perceived, having heard,
hearing.

नि-शाम्य, ind. having seen; having heard; having
tranquillized; having put out (as a light).

2. नि-शान्त, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. निशान्त see under
निशा, p. 504, col. 3), tranquillized, quiet, tranquil,
patient; (अम्), n. a house, dwelling, habitation.
—निशान्त-नारी, f. a house-wife.

निशान्तीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to
a house (?).
नि-शाम, अस्, m. observing, perceiving.
नि-शामयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, perceiving, hearing.

निशरण नि-शरण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. शॄ with
नि), killing, slaughter.

2. नि-शारण, अम्, n. (fr. शॄ with नि), killing,
slaughter, slaying.

नि-शारुक, अस्, m. a kind of Rūpaka (see under
दृढ); (अम्), n. an air, a sort of musical compo-
sition played as an accompaniment to dancing.
निशात नि-शात. See under नि-शो, col. 2.

नि-शात, अस्, आ, अम्, sharpened, whetted, sharp;
polished, burnished, varnished.

निशाद नि-शाद, अस्, m. a man of low caste;
(see निषाद.)
—निशाद-त्व, अम्, n. the state or
condition of a man of low caste.
—निशादा-पुत्र,
[]
अस्, m. (?), a pestle.
—निशादा-शिला, f. a mortar, a
slab for grinding.

नि-षद, अस्, m., N. of an ancient king, (probably
a wrong reading for निषध); = नि-षाद, a musical
note.

नि-षाद, अस्, m., N. of certain wild aboriginal
tribes in India not belonging to the Āryan race, and
described as hunters, fishermen, robbers, &c.; (ac-
cording to Mahī-dhara) a N. of the Bhillas (a wild
mountain tribe whose progenitor is said by a legend
to have sprung from the thigh of Vena); a man of
a degraded tribe in general, an outcast (especially
the son of a Brāhman by a Śūdra woman); the first
of the seven musical notes or more properly the last
[]
or highest of the scale, corresponding to B of our
scale; N. of a Kalpa; [cf. नैषाद, नैषादक,
नैषादिका, नैषादि.]
—निषाद-कर्षु, उस्,
m., N. of a district; [cf. नैषाद-कर्षुक.]
—निषाद-वत्, n., N. of a musical note, = B of
our scale.
निषाद नि-षाद. See 1. नि-षद्, col. 1.

निशामय नि-शामय = शृणु, listen, (impv.
of Caus. of नि-शम्, col. 1.)

निशायिन् नि-शायिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. शी with
नि), lying down in, sleeping in (?).

निशावन निशावन, अस्, m. hemp. See
शण.

नि-शित, अस्, आ, अम्, sharpened, whetted, pointed,
stimulated; (अम्), n. iron.

निशिता नि-शिता, f., Ved. night; [cf. नि-
शीथ.]

नि-शिति, इस्, f., Ved. excitement, stimulation, en-
couragement.

निशिथ नि-शिथ, अस्, m. (for नि-शीथ), N. of
one of the three sons of Doṣā (Night); (some read
this word in Bhāgavata-Purāṇa

निशीथ नि-शीथ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. शी with नि),
midnight, the time of sleep, night in general.

नि-शीथिनी, f. night.
—निशीथिनी-नाथ, अस्, m.
‘husband of night,’ the moon.
नि-शीथ्या, f. night.

निशुम्भ नि-शुम्भ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. शुम्भ्
with नि), killing, slaughter; N. of a Dānava, brother
of Śumbha, slain by Durgā; (also written नि-
सुम्भ.)
—निशुम्भ-मथनी, f. or निशुम्भ-
मर्दिनी, f. ‘destroyer of Niśumbha,’ an epithet of
Durgā.
निसुम्भ नि-सुम्भ. See नि-शुम्भ, p. 505.
नि-शुम्भन, अम्, n. killing, slaying, slaughter.

नि-शुम्भिन्, ई, m. an epithet of Vajra-ṭīka; an
inferior deity of the Buddhists.

निशुष्म नि-शुष्म, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not
sparkling (as fire), not coruscating, (opposed to उच्-
छुष्म.)

निशृम्भ नि-शृम्भ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्रम्भ्
with नि), Ved. stepping firmly?; (Sāy.) fastened to
(a car), harnessed.
निशैत निशैत. See under निशा, col. 1.

निशो नि-शो [cf. नि-शि], cl. 4. P. -श्यति,
-शातुम्, to sharpen, whet, polish.
नि-शान, अम्, n. sharpening; (also read नि-शाण.)

निश्चक्षुस् निश्-चक्षुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, eyeless,
blind.

निश्चत् निश्-चत् (निस्-चत्), Caus. A. -चात-
यते, -यितुम्, Ved. to scare or drive away.

निश्चत्वारिंश निश्-चत्वारिंश, अस्, ई, अम्, with-
out forty.

निश्चप्रच निश्च-प्रच, (perhaps) backwards
and forwards; [cf. आच-पराच under 2. आच.]

निश्चर् निश्-चर् (निस्-चर्), cl. 1. P. -चरति,
-चरितुम्, to come forth, issue, go out, arise, pro-
ceed, appear, be produced; to rise (as sounds): Caus.
-चारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to issue or come forth.

निश्-चर, अस्, m., N. of one of the Saptarṣis in
the eleventh Manv-antara.

निश्-चारक, अम्, n. evacuation by stool; air,
wind; obstinacy, wilfulness.

निश्चल निश्-चल, अस्, आ, अम्, immovable,
not moving, stock-still, still, fixed, steady; not
subject to motion or fluctuation, invariable, un-
changeable; (आ), f. the earth; Desmodium Gange-
ticum (= शाल-पर्णी).
—निश्चल-मति, इस्, इस्, इ,
steady-minded, of unshaken mind.
—निश्चलाङ्ग
(˚ल-अङ्˚), अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having immovable limbs,
[]
firm-bodied, firm; (अस्), m. a species of crane,
Ardea Nivea; a rock, mountain.

निश्चि निश्-चि (निस्-चि, see rt. 2. चि), cl. 3. P.
-चिकेति, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -नुते, -चेतुम्, Ved. to
ascertain, investigate, know thoroughly, arrive at a
certain decision, decide, regard as decided, to fix
upon, determine, resolve.

निश्-चय, अस्, m. ascertainment, investigation,
inquiry, a fixed opinion, a firm conviction, accurate
or certain knowledge, certainty, positiveness, positive
conclusion, determination, resolution, resolve, decision;
settled purpose, fixed intention, design, purpose, aim,
(
इति निश्चयः

, this is a fixed opinion or established
conclusion; निश्चयं ज्ञातुम्, to ascertain the cer-
tainty; निश्चयं कृ, to decide, come to a deter-
mination; cf. पाप-न्˚, मरण-न्˚, एक-न्˚); ‘re-
moval of fallacy or deception,’ N. of a figure in
rhetoric; (एन or आत्), ind. certainly.
—निश्चय-
दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a merchant.
—निश्चय-रूप,
अस्, आ, अम्, having (only) the appearance of cer-
tainty, uncertain, wrong.
निश्-चयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, decided, determined, resolved.

निश्-चायक, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what ascertains
or determines, one who is certain about anything,
determining, decisive.

निश्-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, ascertained, determined,
settled, concluded, decided, established, certain, one
who has come to a conclusion or formed a fixed
opinion; sentenced, pronounced; (अम्), n. certainty,
decision, conclusion; (अम्), ind. decidedly, positively;
(आ), f., N. of a river.
निश्चित्त निश्-चित्त, अस्, m., N. of a Samādhi.

निश्-चिति, इस्, f. ascertainment, fixing, determining,
settling.

निश्-चित्य, ind. having ascertained, having con-
cluded or decided, having made out for certain, having
settled or come to a final decision, feeling assured or
convinced.

निश्-चीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the course of
ascertainment, being under investigation, being con-
cluded.

निश्चिन्त निश्-चिन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, unthinking,
thoughtless, inconsiderate, void of reflection, careless,
unconcerned; [cf. नैश्चिन्त्य.]

निश्चुक्कण निश्-चुक्कण, अम्, n. (said to be
fr. rt. चुक्क्), a sort of tooth-powder prepared from
sulphate of iron &c. which destroys the tartar but
blackens the teeth; (also written निश्-चुक्वण.)

निश्चृत् निश्-चृत्, cl. 6. P. -चृतति, -चर्तितुम्,
Ved. to loosen, untie.

निश्चेतन निश्-चेतन, अस्, आ, अम्, without
consciousness, unconscious, unreasonable.

निश्चेतस् निश्-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, out of one's
mind, not in one's right senses.

निश्-चेष्टा, f. motionlessness.
—निश्चेष्टा-क-
रण, अस्, आ, अम्, causing motionlessness; epithet of
one of the arrows of the god of love.

निश्चौर निश्-चौर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
robbers.

निश्च्यवन निश्-च्यवन, अस्, m. ‘unperish-
ing,’ a form of fire; N. of one of the Saptarṣis in
the second Manv-antara.

निश्छन्दस् निश्-छन्दस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, not
